description: The YouTube video features an interview with Thomas Wolf, co-founder and chief science officer of Hugging Face , discussing the company's foray into robotics with the "Le Robot" project . Wolf draws parallels between the current state of robotics and the earlier "LLM wave," highlighting Hugging Face's goal to democratize AI for physical applications by providing accessible hardware and open-source software.
